<!--
BEFORE YOU POST, please check these. Some of it is genuinely sensitive.

  [ ] No IP addresses. Not the short ones with dots, and especially not the long ones
      full of colons. Those are unique to your household, not just your network.
  [ ] No Wi-Fi network name, no router make or model, no ISP account details.
  [ ] No username, if you personalised it. No password, obviously. And never the
      cluster secret, in any form, even partial.
  [ ] No photographs or screenshots. A photo of a screen carries the whole screen:
      other windows, notifications, whatever else was open. Type the message out
      instead. It has leaked network details before.
  [ ] Peer IDs identify your node. Leave them out unless the problem cannot be
      described without one.

Replace anything you remove with a placeholder like <my address> or 192.168.1.42.
If your assistant is writing this for you, it should have shown you the full text first.
-->
